notes: TIMESTAMPTZ implies TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE.
Consider adding database indexes to Foreign Keys and frequently queried columns for performance.
Soft deletes (using deleted_at) are included for Employees and Contracts. Consider for other tables if needed.
Enum-like fields are represented as VARCHAR; actual implementation might use ENUM types or check constraints.
Default values (like CURRENT_TIMESTAMP or sequences for IDs) should be added during table creation script generation.

users.description: Stores user accounts for login and identity.

roles.description: Defines user roles within the system.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Unique name of the role (e.g., Admin, Leader, Sales).

permissions.description: Defines specific permissions that can be granted to roles.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Unique name of the permission (e.g., view_margin, edit_contract).

columns.name: description
columns.description: Description of what the permission allows.

user_roles.description: Junction table linking users to roles (Many-to-Many).

role_permissions.description: Junction table linking roles to permissions (Many-to-Many).

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Link to the user account (optional, if employee is a system user).

columns.name: internal_account
columns.description: Internal system account name, if different from username.

columns.name: reporting_leader_id
columns.description: Link to the user ID of the direct manager/leader.

columns.name: current_status
columns.description: Current working status (Allocated, Available, EndingSoon, OnLeave, Resigned).

columns.name: status_updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the status was last updated.

columns.name: profile_picture_url
columns.description: URL to the employee's profile picture.

columns.name: updated_by
columns.description: User who last updated this record.

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.description: Timestamp for soft delete. Null if not deleted.

skill_categories.description: Stores categories for grouping skills (e.g., Programming Language, Framework).

skills.description: Stores the master list of skills available in the system.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Name of the skill (e.g., Java, Spring Boot). Unique within a category assumed.

employee_skills.description: Junction table linking employees to skills, including experience and assessment levels.

columns.name: years_experience
columns.description: Years of experience with the skill.

columns.name: self_assessment_level
columns.description: Level assessed by employee (Basic, Intermediate, Advanced).

columns.name: leader_assessment_level
columns.description: Level assessed by leader (Basic, Intermediate, Advanced).

project_history.description: Stores the history of projects an employee has worked on.

employee_status_log.description: Logs changes in employee status over time.

columns.name: project_name
columns.description: Project name if status is 'Allocated' or 'EndingSoon'.

columns.name: expected_end_date
columns.description: Expected end date if status is 'EndingSoon'.

columns.name: log_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the status change occurred or was logged.

employee_costs.description: Stores monthly cost associated with each employee for margin calculation.

columns.name: cost_amount
columns.description: Total cost for the employee in this month.

columns.name: currency
columns.description: Currency of the cost amount (e.g., VND, USD).

columns.name: description
columns.description: Optional notes about the cost calculation.

employee_revenues.description: Stores calculated monthly revenue generated by each employee per contract.

columns.name: billing_rate
columns.description: Billing rate used for calculation (if applicable, e.g., T&M).

columns.name: allocation_percentage
columns.description: Percentage allocated to this contract in this month.

columns.name: calculated_revenue
columns.description: Revenue amount calculated for this employee, contract, and month.

opportunities.description: Stores opportunities, potentially synced from Hubspot.

columns.name: deal_stage
columns.description: Current stage in the sales pipeline.

columns.name: source
columns.description: Origin of the opportunity (e.g., Hubspot, Manual).

columns.name: assigned_sales_id
columns.description: Sales user responsible for the opportunity.

columns.name: last_interaction_date
columns.description: Timestamp of the last logged interaction.

columns.name: onsite_priority
columns.description: Flag indicating if onsite resources are preferred.

columns.name: sync_status
columns.description: Status of the last sync attempt (Success, Failed, Pending).

columns.name: last_sync_at
columns.description: Timestamp of the last successful sync.

opportunity_assignments.description: Links Leaders (users) to opportunities they are assigned to follow.

columns.name: leader_id
columns.description: User ID of the assigned Leader.

columns.name: assigned_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the assignment was made.

opportunity_notes.description: Stores notes and interaction logs related to opportunities.

columns.name: note_content
columns.description: Content of the note or log entry.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Name of the contract or project.

columns.name: assigned_sales_id
columns.description: Sales user responsible for the contract.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Current status of the contract (New, Ongoing, Paused, Completed, Cancelled).

contract_payment_terms.description: Stores payment milestones and statuses for each contract.

columns.name: notes
columns.description: Notes related to this payment term.

contract_employees.description: Junction table linking employees to contracts they are working on.

columns.name: allocation_percentage
columns.description: Percentage of time allocated to this contract.

columns.name: start_date
columns.description: Start date of involvement in the contract.

columns.name: end_date
columns.description: End date of involvement in the contract.

contract_files.description: Stores metadata about files attached to contracts.

columns.name: file_name
columns.description: Original name of the uploaded file.

columns.name: file_path
columns.description: Path or key to the stored file (e.g., in S3 or local storage).

columns.name: file_size
columns.description: Size of the file in bytes.

columns.name: uploaded_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the file was uploaded.

sales_kpis.description: Stores target revenue KPIs for sales users per period.

columns.name: sales_user_id
columns.description: User ID of the sales person.

columns.name: target_revenue
columns.description: Target revenue amount for the period.

columns.name: config_key
columns.description: Unique key identifying the configuration parameter.

columns.name: is_read
columns.description: Flag indicating if the user has read the notification.

columns.name: related_entity_type
columns.description: Type of entity the notification relates to (e.g., Contract, Opportunity).
